## Evidence gates

- [ ] **PLAN** — acceptance criteria and non-duplication evidence attached
- [ ] **TDD** — RED and GREEN evidence attached for every code change
- [ ] **BUILD** — unit, lint and APK build evidence attached
- [ ] **REVIEW** — independent code, design, backend/security and regression reviews resolved
- [ ] **VISUAL** — golden/emulator screenshots reviewed; generated assets include provenance
- [ ] **RUNTIME** — emulator smoke completed without crash or ANR
- [ ] `python3 scripts/cycle.py validate` passes
